title: Hey Joe
hook: Why Hey Joe sounds like *running out of road*

chords.name: C
chords.text: It starts on *C*, far from home in E.

chords.name: D
chords.text: Up again: *D*, and an F♯ sneaks in.

chords.name: E
chords.text: *E major* at last. Its G♯ hits like a wall.

chords.name: C
chords.text: Then back down to C. *Running again*.

question: Hendrix's most underrated chord move? 👇
